consent.text: Participation is voluntary. The study records task timing, task outcomes, safety-grading answers, and an irreversibly hashed participant pseudonym. Do not enter names, email addresses, agency identifiers, incident-sensitive information, or other direct identifiers. You may stop at any time before submission; withdrawal after submission uses the session receipt.

privacy.retention: Retain deidentified result records according to the reviewer-approved study policy.
privacy.purposeLimitation: Operational usability and dangerous-misinterpretation evaluation only.

participantInstructions: Use a non-identifying pseudonym supplied for this study.
Operate the local VIGIA release identified by the facilitator.
State when the evidence is insufficient; do not guess.
Complete each task in order and return to this terminal for outcome capture.
facilitatorScript: Verify release ID and evidence bundle fingerprint.
Confirm the participant is not using a direct identifier.
Read the consent text verbatim and record voluntary consent.
Start the local operator environment and give no task-solving hints.
For each task, start timing only after the participant confirms readiness.
Record environment outcome and safety grading from direct observation.
Provide the session receipt and withdrawal procedure.

tasks.name: Identify the top incident
tasks.instruction: Select the incident requiring the highest immediate attention and cite the visible basis.

tasks.name: Explain the assessment
tasks.instruction: Explain why the assessment is strong, weak, or blocked without overstating certainty.

tasks.name: Distinguish evidence families
tasks.instruction: Separate physical observations, human reports, official records, and context.

tasks.name: Identify a contradiction
tasks.instruction: Find a contradiction and explain whether it changes the operational claim.

tasks.name: Identify the decision blocker
tasks.instruction: Name the unresolved fact preventing the next decision.

tasks.name: Explain source selection
tasks.instruction: Explain why the recommended acquisition is useful and what it cannot prove.

tasks.name: Complete a handoff
tasks.instruction: Produce a handoff containing known facts, unknowns, authority limits, and next action.

tasks.name: Recover from degraded state
tasks.instruction: Respond to a provider degradation without treating stale data as current.

tasks.name: Review authority boundary
tasks.instruction: Decide whether the proposed action is advisory, approval-gated, or forbidden.

tasks.name: Perform replay
tasks.instruction: Replay the incident cutoff and verify that later facts did not leak into the earlier decision.

completion.pass: Task objective achieved using visible VIGIA evidence.
completion.fail: Objective incomplete or achieved using information outside the evaluation environment.

dangerousIf: weather context represented as physical fire proof
retrospective truth used as issue-time fact
advisory authority represented as execution authority
contradiction hidden or ignored in a consequential decision

trace.pass: Start, finish, duration, completion, environment outcome, and safety decision are recorded for every task.
